name: my-ai-skills
description: Personal AI skills library for agents, coding assistants, and automation tools.

skills.name: Data Analysis
skills.description: Analyze CSV or Excel files and generate Markdown reports.

inputs.name: input_file
inputs.description: CSV or Excel file to analyze.

inputs.name: output_file
inputs.description: Markdown report output path.

skills.name: To PRD
skills.description: Synthesize conversation and codebase context into a structured PRD in Markdown.

inputs.name: conversation_context
inputs.description: User goal, prior discussion, or decision context.

inputs.name: codebase_context
inputs.description: Relevant repository context when the PRD depends on existing implementation.

inputs.name: output_file
inputs.description: Optional Markdown output path for the generated PRD.

skills.name: Write a Skill
skills.description: Create a new agent skill with structure, trigger guidance, and supporting resources.

inputs.name: task_description
inputs.description: What the new skill should help an agent do.

inputs.name: usage_examples
inputs.description: Optional examples, keywords, or triggering phrases.

skills.name: Lovable GitHub Cloudflare Worker
skills.description: Stabilize a Lovable-generated project into a GitHub-managed and Cloudflare Worker-ready delivery pipeline.

inputs.name: project_path
inputs.description: Local path to the Lovable-generated project.

inputs.name: github_repo
inputs.description: Target GitHub repository URL or identifier.

inputs.name: cloudflare_target
inputs.description: Worker name, routes, bindings, and deployment constraints.

skills.name: MCP Builder
skills.description: Guide MCP server setup, Warp integration, and validation steps for new tools or services.

inputs.name: server_name
inputs.description: Name of the MCP server or external tool to integrate.

inputs.name: integration_context
inputs.description: Authentication, install, or environment requirements.

skills.name: Website Custom Optimizer
skills.description: Diagnose and optimize websites, landing pages, product pages, service pages, enrollment pages, internal portals, and knowledge bases for clarity, trust, SEO, UX, CRO, mobile experience, performance, accessibility, launch readiness, and execution planning.

inputs.name: website_or_page
inputs.description: Website URL, page content, screenshot summary, existing copy, or project description to optimize.

inputs.name: website_type
inputs.description: Website or page type. Defaults to auto_detect.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: Primary optimization goal such as conversion, SEO, trust, usability, performance, accessibility, branding, or launch readiness.

inputs.name: target_audience
inputs.description: Primary user group, customer segment, visitor intent, or stakeholder audience.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: quick, standard, full, launch, or cro. Defaults to standard.

skills.notes: Do not fabricate social proof, metrics, testimonials, media coverage, or certifications. Avoid dark patterns. Ask for authorization before browser automation, crawling, third-party processing, or analyzing non-public content.

skills.name: Full Sprint
skills.description: Turn a high-level goal into an executable, verifiable, pauseable, resumable, auditable sprint contract and continue PLAN → ACT → VERIFY → REVIEW → ITERATE within explicit safety, scope, validation, and budget limits.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: High-level engineering, refactor, documentation, migration, prototype, or feature delivery goal.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Files, directories, modules, or documents that may be modified.

inputs.name: out_of_scope
inputs.description: Explicitly forbidden areas such as schema, CI/CD, secrets, deploy config, auth, or public API.

inputs.name: success_criteria
inputs.description: Checklist of conditions that must be true before completion.

inputs.name: validation_commands
inputs.description: Commands or checks used to verify each checkpoint and final completion.

inputs.name: permission_profile
inputs.description: read-only, suggest, auto-edit, or full-sprint. Defaults to auto-edit unless full-sprint is explicitly requested.

skills.notes: Do not enter full-sprint if scope, success criteria, or validation are missing. Stop for approval before production deploy, destructive database operations, secrets, credentials, permissions, mass delete, CI/CD, dependencies, public API, schema, migration, or data format changes.

skills.name: Google Ads AI Copilot
skills.description: Analyze Google Ads performance and produce read-only health reports, search term audits, negative keyword suggestions, RSA copy ideas, budget pacing, action queues, and n8n/Notion/MCP integration plans with human approval required before write or spend-impacting operations.

inputs.name: ads_data
inputs.description: Google Ads report data, campaign summary, keyword data, search terms, conversion data, or screenshot summary.

inputs.name: business_context
inputs.description: Business, offer, audience, location, service area, monthly budget, campaign goal, and constraints.

inputs.name: task_type
inputs.description: health_report, search_terms_audit, ad_copy, budget_pacing, funnel_diagnosis, automation_plan, or action_queue.

inputs.name: approval_mode
inputs.description: read_only, approval_required, or approved_write. Defaults to read_only.

skills.notes: Default to read-only analysis. Do not delete campaigns, expose credentials, fabricate performance claims, or execute Google Ads mutate, Notion write, n8n workflow update, or MCP write operations without explicit human approval for that specific action. Budget changes must not exceed 20% per action.

skills.name: 智能文件角色適應器
skills.description: Adapt to Notion document type, content maturity, and user intent, then switch into the most useful assistant role to summarize, restructure, rewrite, fill gaps, critique, convert formats, or produce action-ready documentation.

inputs.name: document_content
inputs.description: Notion page content, notes, SOP draft, meeting notes, strategy draft, spec, learning notes, or database page content.

inputs.name: user_intent
inputs.description: What the user wants: understand, summarize, rewrite, fill gaps, critique, convert format, or produce actions.

inputs.name: target_format
inputs.description: summary, sop, strategy, prd, technical_spec, learning_notes, meeting_notes, action_plan, or auto_detect.

skills.notes: Do not invent facts; mark uncertain information as 待確認. Preserve important source meaning and tone unless the user asks for a rewrite. Do not expose sensitive Notion content to public repositories or third-party systems.

skills.name: research-lab — AI 研究實驗室
skills.description: Break complex research, investigation, market analysis, product analysis, competitor analysis, technical trend research, business model analysis, growth strategy, SEO/GEO, education, AI, or tutoring topics into verifiable breadth scans, depth dives, cross-validation, and decision-ready reports.

inputs.name: research_topic
inputs.description: Research topic, keyword, market, product, strategy, technology, or decision question.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: full, breadth_only, depth_only, or quick. Defaults to full when not specified.

inputs.name: decision_context
inputs.description: Decision use case, constraints, time range, geography, industry scope, and required depth.

inputs.name: source_materials
inputs.description: Optional documents, links, notes, competitor names, data, or prior research.

skills.notes: Tie every subtask back to the original research topic. Separate facts, inferences, and recommendations. Mark uncertainty and confidence for risky conclusions. Do not invent sources, evidence, or statistics.

skills.name: Managing Public Relations
skills.description: Build public relations strategy, brand messaging, stakeholder communication, PESO media strategy, media interview preparation, and crisis response plans.

inputs.name: brand_or_event_context
inputs.description: Brand background, event summary, current situation, public issue, complaint, backlash, or crisis context.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: awareness, trust, investment, partnership, crisis_repair, media_interview, brand_story, or stakeholder_alignment.

inputs.name: stakeholders
inputs.description: Consumers, investors, employees, media, government, suppliers, partners, community, or other stakeholders.

inputs.name: risks_and_constraints
inputs.description: Legal risk, known facts, unknown facts, regulatory concerns, customer harm, employee impact, public sentiment, or timing constraints.

skills.notes: Do not help conceal major facts, fabricate evidence, manipulate media, or mislead stakeholders. High-risk crisis issues require legal counsel and professional PR support.

skills.name: Weather API
skills.description: Query current weather by city name.

skills.name: Awesome Agent Skills
skills.description: Community-maintained collection of agent skills and references.
skills.notes: Use this as an index to discover community skills. Read target repository docs before using any linked skill.

skills.name: Sentry Skills
skills.description: Reference source for AGENTS.md authoring, code review, bug finding, and skill authoring workflows.
skills.notes: Reference-only by default. Read the repository README and target skill docs before use.

skills.name: PM Skills
skills.description: Reference source for PRDs, discovery, roadmap planning, and structured product workflows.
skills.notes: Prefer this repo when a task needs product planning structure or multi-step PM workflows.

skills.name: Firecrawl CLI
skills.description: Reference source for public web research, search, scraping, crawling, and site mapping workflows.
skills.notes: Use only for public web tasks. Confirm network usage and any paid API requirements before execution.

skills.name: Nutrient Agent Skill
skills.description: Reference source for OCR, document conversion, extraction, and PII redaction workflows.
skills.notes: Requires explicit approval before sending documents to third-party services.

skills.name: Claude SEO
skills.description: Reference source for deep SEO audits, schema analysis, GEO, and website optimization workflows.
skills.notes: Use when advanced SEO analysis is needed and networked tools are acceptable.

skills.name: Tutor Skills
skills.description: Reference source for study-vault generation, tutoring flows, and curriculum-style knowledge workflows.
skills.notes: Best for tutoring or learning tasks that benefit from generated notes and quiz loops.

skills.name: CodeRabbit Skills
skills.description: Reference source for PR review and guarded autofix workflows when CodeRabbit is already in use.
skills.notes: Use only when the repository already has CodeRabbit configured and authenticated.

skills.name: Cloudflare Skills
skills.description: Official Cloudflare agent skills for Workers, Pages, KV, D1, R2, AI, Tunnel, WAF, Wrangler, Durable Objects, Agents SDK, Email Service, web performance, and MCP server references.
skills.notes: Use as official Cloudflare guidance. Before executing Wrangler, MCP, deploy, or API operations, confirm target account, project, environment, and credentials. Do not expose Cloudflare API tokens.
